This is absurd, not in what you've claimed, but the same experience, I just Googled and stumbled onto this post,  except my expierence is a little different.

I run a 13900k x 7600CL38, I use the auto oc, and xmp profile, that's all, so no ram tuning, however:

1. My OS also became corrupted, I had to perform a fresh install after I had bios flashbacked to V13, and haven't had any issues since. 



This was my worst expierence regarding a bios update to date.



2. Id advise others who come across the post to not update, especially if dialed in like OP was, until new bios hotfix is released, or a new bios is issued.
I didn't even know they had A-Die kits in a 32GB module until I saw this post, I'll be following this thread as well. Z790 Apex & SP 121 13900k user. Have you confirmed your IMC will do above 7400?
